name: Bec Vaughan
headline: Chief of Staff & Director International Product at Oracle NetSuite | AI Innovation Leader | Startup Mentor | Global Product Strategy | DE&I Champion
about:
Strategic leader driving organizational excellence and international product innovation at Oracle NetSuite.

As Chief of Staff to the SVP of Target Markets & Cash & Profits, I orchestrate complex initiatives across global teams while leading our Product Management Office. My expertise spans AI-driven innovation, localization excellence, and building products that resonate locally in global markets.

With 10+ years at Oracle NetSuite and deep experience in eCommerce, I excel at:
- Building high-performing, cross-functional teams across international boundaries
- Driving AI transformation initiatives to enhance product capabilities
- Championing DE&I methodologies for inclusive leadership and product development
- Mentoring tech startups to scale their solutions and enter new markets

I'm passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex business challenges while fostering inclusive cultures that drive innovation. As a startup advisor with Grand Central Tech and Entrepreneurs Roundtable Accelerator, I help emerging companies navigate growth challenges and scale internationally.

Let's connect if you're interested in international product strategy, AI implementation, startup growth, or building inclusive tech organizations.
… more

Providing advice, networking opportunities and expertise to the cohort of start-ups in the ERA accelerator program.

It's alumni companies have raised more than $300 Million in investor capital.

H-Lister was a start-up that closed after two years.

Heading the Solutions team, we act as a bridge between clients and technologists. Our role is to solve business process and functionality problems in the most effective, client-pleasing way possible, whether during a new eCommerce site build, adding new functionality, or adapting to changing business needs. 

My role is to ensure the team is clear on day-to-day priorities as well as strategic drivers and that our internal and external customers can rely on us to produce innovative solutions on a daily basis. 

I also lead the Innovation program which drives company wide innovation & improvement initiatives.

My role as Solution Engineer at Venda is a role requiring exceptional post-sales, technical, and communication capabilities. I work closely with the project management and technical teams, gathering requirements from clients, analyzing their business and technical needs. I ensure the client’s data structure, data flows, business processes, features, usability, and web design are all best practice. 

In other words, I am responsible that the design of the solution on the Venda platform meets the customer’s business needs and that their internal processes are aligned to get the best out of the platform.

I act as an advocate for the client and help ensure that the solution is the best fit (in a holistic sense) for the client.

My role involves:
• Identification of client problems, processing and business drivers and understanding the context and constraints under which they operate
• Proactive discovery of the underlying business goal for every client’s decision
• Creative solutions to business problems faced by clients
• Performing functional/configuration analysis associated with work orders and project requests
• Design and documentation of data flows, processes, and business rules – both textually and visually
• Creation and maintainance of requirements documentation, including Use Cases – both high level (for estimates)
• Application of best practice (including usability, SEO, branding, etc.) to every implementation
• Working across multiple opportunities/projects simultaneously, using both waterfall and agile methodologies.

Clients I have worked with include:
• Accessorize
• Monsoon
• Boohoo
• Republic
• Urban Outfitters
• Universal Music
• CapGemini

I joined Paperchase as Project Manager for their new eCommerce platform. My responsibilities were to get the company through the ITT process and initialise set up of an eCommerce platform. The main tasks involved documenting the full functional requirements and assessing the ITT respondents, liaising with the 3rd Party platform vendors to fully understand their offer and ensure the chosen vendor meets all Paperchase deliverables. This was accomplished by:
~	Documenting the full functional requirements, including technical, infrastructure, and 3rd Party
~	Documenting the technical specifications for system integration.
~	Planning optimum data integrity across stock, product and customer data.
~	Working with the 3rd party eCommerce platform technical managers to ensure they fully understood the deliverables and that their solutions were robust, and would be delivered on time and to budget.
~	Co-ordinating internal owners, stakeholders and interests parties through plans, workshops to ensure that deliverables were understood and work-streams agreed.
~	Management of the IS project plans, both technical and non-technical, including all CAPEX / OPEX documentation.
~	Hand-over to the 3rd Party Project Manager once a decision was made.
